summary: 'IgnoredStopGoPenalty' commentary emitter. Guarded by the race-active flag dword_7D0308, the nonzero track-condition float flt_7CF3C8, and a non-NULL vehicle pointer a1. When the player vehicle pointer dword_7C54E8 is nonzero and equals a1, and a2 is non-NULL and matches the aIgnoredStopGoP literal, sets event code 149; otherwise, when a2 matches aIgnoredStopGoP on the AI path, sets event code 243. Both paths share one emission sequence: StructInitWithSentinelValues, DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion(v3, v2, *(a1+0x489C), ...), and InsertDriverTableEntry(flt_5EA618, v3) into the session event table.

local_names.a2: penalty event text, matched against aIgnoredStopGoP
local_names.v2: event code: 149 for the player path, 243 for the AI path
local_names.v3: local 8-float event struct, sentinel-initialized then filled by lookup

operations.description: Enter only when dword_7D0308 (race active) is nonzero, flt_7CF3C8 (track condition) != 0.0, and a1 (vehicle pointer) is nonzero.
Take the player path when dword_7C54E8 (player vehicle pointer) is nonzero and equals a1.
Player path: require a2 to be non-NULL and strcmp(aIgnoredStopGoP, a2) == 0.
Set v2 = 149, the player ignored-stop-go-penalty event code.
StructInitWithSentinelValues(v3) initializes the local 8-float event struct with sentinel values.
DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion(v3, v2, *(a1+0x489C), -1, -1, -1, -2.0, -2.0) fills the struct with event code v2 and the driver id at a1+0x489C as context.
InsertDriverTableEntry(flt_5EA618, v3) inserts the filled event struct into the session event table.
AI path (else branch): require a2 to be non-NULL and strcmp(aIgnoredStopGoP, a2) == 0.
Set v2 = 243, the AI ignored-stop-go-penalty event code, then jump to the shared emission sequence (StructInitWithSentinelValues / DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion / InsertDriverTableEntry).

Shared emission sequence for the AI path: StructInitWithSentinelValues(v3); DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion(v3, 243, *(a1+0x489C), -1, -1, -1, -2.0, -2.0); InsertDriverTableEntry(flt_5EA618, v3).

unresolved: flt_59E440 is listed as a read global in the packet but never appears in the raw source text; likely a zero-comparison constant folded into the '!= 0.0' guard, unproven.
Event codes 149 and 243 are not named in the packet; the player/AI interpretation follows the existing analysis and the player-pointer comparison.
The field evidence base is named 'this' while the raw source reads offset 0x489C on the a1 vehicle pointer; the equivalence is inferred from the identical offset.
The exact structure of the session event table at flt_5EA618 and the meaning of the -1 / -2.0 lookup arguments are unknown.
